$meta.title: Boot sequence
$meta.description: Version, the boot menu, and the strings the machine prints on the way up.
$meta.warning: Generated file — edit the BIOS source and re-run the extractor, not this.

menu.escape: ESC ($1B) boots the Monitor through BRK
menu.note: Any other key is consumed and costs one tick. Input arriving before the probe finishes sits unread in the ACIA and blocks the bytes behind it.

sequence.step: KernalInit — probe and initialise every card, interrupts still disabled
Beep — guarded, skipped when no SID is fitted
If BOOT_VECTOR ($035B) is non-zero, jmp through it (cartridge takeover)
Halt if neither video nor serial is present — there is no console to boot into
cli, then draw the splash on whichever console this machine has
Wait ~5 s for ENTER or ESC; time out into BASIC
